goal: Recode the gene to eliminate the ACG codon while maintaining the ORFs of both trpA and trpB
hypothesis: The gene has trpA in frame 0 (ATG..CTC TAA, nt 0-62) and trpB in frame +1 (ATG at nt 73..TAA at end). recode_codons only works on frame 0, so it can't remove ACG from trpB (its ACGs sit out of frame 0). A frame-aware recoder is needed that recodes each ORF in its own frame, followed by a per-ORF checker and filters.

criteria.claim: In the recoded DNA sequence, no in-frame codon in the reading frame of trpA or trpB is ACG.
The recoded sequence contains a trpA ORF with the same start codon, a protein translation identical to the original trpA, and a terminating stop codon, with no premature stops.
The recoded sequence contains a trpB ORF with the same start codon, a protein translation identical to the original trpB, and a terminating stop codon, with no premature stops.
The output is a valid DNA sequence (only A, C, G, T) that is a recoded version of the input gene, with trpA and trpB in the same relative positions and orientation as the original.

plan.hypothesis: The gene has trpA in frame 0 (ATG..CTC TAA, nt 0-62) and trpB in frame +1 (ATG at nt 73..TAA at end). recode_codons only works on frame 0, so it can't remove ACG from trpB (its ACGs sit out of frame 0). A frame-aware recoder is needed that recodes each ORF in its own frame, followed by a per-ORF checker and filters.
plan.expected: A recoded DNA of the same length, with ACG replaced synonymously in both ORFs, so trpA and trpB proteins are identical, start ATG and terminal TAA are kept, and no in-frame ACG remains in either ORF. Filters on acg count and ORF defect counts all take the yes branch.

assertions.claim: Recoded sequence has zero ACG in-frame codons in trpA and trpB.
trpA keeps ATG start, identical protein, terminal stop, no premature stops.
trpB keeps ATG start, identical protein, terminal stop, no premature stops.
Output is valid ACGT DNA with ORFs in the same positions and orientation.

recode.why: Remove ACG in both trpA (frame 0) and trpB (frame +1) synonymously.

check.why: Score ACG count and ORF integrity of both ORFs.

f_acg.why: No in-frame ACG remains in either ORF.

recode_orf_codons.name: recode_orf_codons
recode_orf_codons.purpose: Replace target codons with synonymous non-target codons, in each of several ORFs given by 0-based start offsets, each in its own reading frame, leaving everything outside the ORFs unchanged.

config_fields.name: orf_starts
config_fields.description: 0-based start offsets of ORFs, as strings

recode_orf_codons.why_needed: trpA is in frame 0 and trpB in frame +1 (starts at nt 73), so ACG codons in trpB must be recoded in that frame, which recode_codons cannot do.
recode_orf_codons.why_not_composable: recode_codons acts only on frame 0 of the whole sequence; mutate_synonymous is random and also frame 0; no slicing/frame-shift node exists.
recode_orf_codons.example: gene with targets=[ACG], orf_starts=[0,73] -> same sequence with ACG in trpA frame and trpB frame replaced by ACC (Thr), all else unchanged

orf_acg_check.name: orf_acg_check
orf_acg_check.purpose: For a recoded DNA, given the original, report per ORF: number of in-frame target codons, and defects (start codon changed, protein differs from original, premature stop, missing terminal stop), plus layout defects (non-ACGT chars, length/position change).
orf_acg_check.why_needed: Need to verify both ORFs in their own frames, which codon_count and dna_atom_score cannot do.
orf_acg_check.why_not_composable: codon_count only checks frame 0; dna_atom_score compares only a single whole-sequence frame-0 protein.
orf_acg_check.example: recoded gene vs original, orf_starts=[0,73], codon ACG -> acg_in_orf_count=0, trpa_orf_defects=0, trpb_orf_defects=0, layout_defects=0
